nodes.speaker: derpy
nodes.text: Hi! I don't think we've met...

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Hi, yes, you're right. I'm new bartender here.

nodes.speaker: derpy
nodes.text: I run the post office here, so if you need to order something with delivery, feel free to contact me.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: How did you get so much alcohol on sale?

nodes.speaker: derpy
nodes.text: You don't quite understand what I'm doing.

nodes.speaker: derpy
nodes.text: I don't sell things, I just buy them with your money and deliver them to you from various places.

nodes.speaker: derpy
nodes.text: Especially for you, I found a supply channel in one town with a lot of alcohol for your bar.

nodes.speaker: derpy
nodes.text: They have so much of it there that it's unlikely to ever end.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Oh... thanks. What would I do without you...

nodes.speaker: derpy
nodes.text: You would only sell an apple juice, lol

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Why are you delivering the goods so quickly? I don't even make it to the bar in time...
